commits.summary: Freeze original test selection and history ranking (verification pending)
commits.body:
A local JVMTI collector observes upstream test processes and their child JVMs without replacing subject bytecode. Rank a changed body below the actual public boundary or after the return on the same retained receiver. Keep raw chronological events, method descriptors, original loaded bytes, JDK, test provenance and per-test plain-run parity. The ranking takes no historical candidate names.

A JDK 21 parent and child each reported two actual nested calls and exactly one later event on the retained receiver. The equal-type different object earned no later-call credit. The original inventory selected one and four classes in the two Parquet modules. Jobs 20261127-044137-rank-original-parquet-old-test-histories, 20261127-044138-rank-original-parquet-new-test-histories and 20261127-044138-rank-original-parquet-new-reversed-overl preserve both original 113-entry graphs and the reversed overlay. All 55 change-selected suites passed.

commits.summary: Attribute hidden caller histories before opening predictions
commits.body:
Resolve original public Java member descriptors, selected input arms, conditional branches, typed literals and retained object handles with javac source attribution. The evaluator seals these with the complete original observation, named components and historical side scopes. The reviewed producer receives registered operations and input meanings while original outcomes stay in the evaluator. Equivalent routes can map independently witnessed public actions and representation encodings.

On the disclosed message-copy fixture the analyzer resolved twelve public calls and three distinct-handle obligations without executing the subject. Verified that the reviewed view has no original side results, the eight scalar scorer controls still reject their alterations, embedded Javadoc listings are removed, and all five previously sealed URL packets regenerate byte for byte.
